newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Phelps Dodge downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Phelps Dodge downgraded.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities inc said Monday it cut its intermediate-term rating on Phelps Dodge Corp to market performer from outperform. The ratings change reflects that the short-term price target on the stock has been met.
-- Phelps Dodge reported stronger-than-expected fourth quarter results, due to higher copper shipments and lower expenses, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said its near-term price target on the stock is $76 a share and its long-term objective is $84.
